check.text: RECORD COMPLETE: 87 CHOICES, 10 FIGHTS REPLAYED AND MATCHED

event.name: A Field Hospital
event.text: A hospital overrun with wounded. The surgeon looks up: "You. Hands. Now."

options.label: HELP OUT
options.text: Everyone loses 15% of max MP. A potion and a phoenix feather, from the stores.

event.name: An Old Banner
event.text: A war banner, half-buried in the mud. Its company's drill is written on the back.

notes: An Old Banner: take the drill.
Gained the Pyre of heroes formation.
the Cleric joins at the fire.

event.name: The Quartermaster's Wagon
event.text: An army wagon, and a quartermaster happy to sell what the army won't miss.

options.label: TAKE THE SPARE KIT
options.text: A common piece and a potion.

notes: The Quartermaster's Wagon: buy the bundle.
Room for one more at camp: 3 seats.
Act 2: The Fire Mine. The Giant's Forge waits at the end.
Took a tome: the Cleric learns Raise.

event.name: An Old Soldier
event.text: A grey-haired soldier sharpening a blade by the road. "Still got some fight in me. Or some sense, if you'd rather."

options.label: TAKE HIM IN
options.text: He joins you, knowing two abilities.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Three members each learn an ability or train one; he stays by the road.

event.name: A Mana Spring
event.text: A pool that glows a faint blue. The water stings.

options.label: BATHE
options.text: Everyone back to full MP; everyone loses 15% of max HP.

options.label: FILL A FLASK
options.text: A tonic and 20 gold's worth of glowing stones.

event.name: A Rival Company
event.text: Another party shares the road. Their captain eyes your newest recruit. "A trade? One of yours for one of ours, sight unseen."

options.label: TRADE
options.text: Your newest member (never the leader) leaves; their gear stays in your bag. One of theirs joins, knowing all three abilities.

notes.text: Act 1: The Old Road. The Chief's Return waits at the end.
